title: MkLinux and the pimped-out Apple Workgroup Server 9150
summary: This article explores MkLinux, a historical port of Linux to PowerPC-based Apple computers, specifically featuring the Workgroup Server 9150. It covers the technical journey of running Linux on vintage Apple hardware with various hardware modifications ('pimped-out' upgrades).
problem_solved: Bringing Linux operating system capabilities to vintage Apple PowerPC hardware for extended use beyond original macOS support.
why_valuable: Preserves computing history by documenting the technical achievement of porting Linux to alternative architectures and the creative modifications to extend vintage hardware life.
